cond_0001.intro: Work as a Mechanical Design Engineer designing process custom piping equipment. Your work stays fresh because each treatment and system design is different. This position requires someone who enjoys being challenged and can apply knowledge and resourcefulness to each design application.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Develop skid-mounted capital equipment by studying customer requirements; researching and testing manufacturing and assembly methods and materials; and soliciting observations from operators.
Mechanical and methodical know-how in the design of structural frame-supported piping systems.
Selects and sizes mechanical components based on process design criteria.
Works with engineers and clients to accurately depict the desired design characteristics.
Develops manufacturing processes by designing and modifying equipment for fabricating, building, assembling, and installing components.
Produces drawings (detailed and outline designs) using standard drafting procedures.
Interfaces with outside vendors for component selection; manufacturing and assembly instructions.
Assures system and product quality by designing testing methods; testing finished product and system capabilities; and confirming fabrication, assembly, and installation processes.
Specifies system components or direct modification of products to ensure conformance with engineering design and performance specifications following testing results.
Reads and interprets blueprints, technical drawings, schematics, and computer-generated reports.
Provides engineering support by answering questions and requests from inside or outside the organization.
Seeks outside resources to assist with implementing operating procedures, resolve system malfunctions, and seek technical support/information.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's degree or equivalent from a two-year college or technical school; or two to five years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with 3D AutoCAD.
Experience working directly with vendors in component sizing and selection.
Ability to perform calculations for stress, deflection, pipe size, pipe pressure drop, pump, and valve sizing.
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, etc.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, etc.
3D AutoCAD design software; Internet software; Excel spreadsheet software and Word, Adobe word processing software.
Preferred Requirements
BS in Mechanical or Structural Engineering.
Experience in a similar drafting/design role.
Experience specifying system components for operation and monitoring of filtration systems or similar technologies/equipment.
Process piping design experience.
SolidWorks experience.
InFlow Inventory software experience.

This position requires someone who enjoys being challenged and can apply knowledge and resourcefulness to each design application.
cond_0030.responsibilities:
Develop skid-mounted capital equipment by studying customer requirements; researching and testing manufacturing and assembly methods and materials; and soliciting observations from operators.
Mechanical and methodical know-how in the design of structural frame-supported piping systems.
Selects and sizes mechanical components based on process design criteria.
Works with engineers and clients to accurately depict the desired design characteristics.
Develops manufacturing processes by designing and modifying equipment for fabricating, building, assembling, and installing components.
Produces drawings (detailed and outline designs) using standard drafting procedures.
Interfaces with outside vendors for component selection; manufacturing and assembly instructions.
Assures system and product quality by designing testing methods; testing finished product and system capabilities; and confirming fabrication, assembly, and installation processes.
Specifies system components or direct modification of products to ensure conformance with engineering design and performance specifications following testing results.
Reads and interprets blueprints, technical drawings, schematics, and computer-generated reports.
Provides engineering support by answering questions and requests from inside or outside the organization.
Seeks outside resources to assist with implementing operating procedures, resolve system malfunctions, and seek technical support/information.
cond_0030.requirements:
Associate's degree or equivalent from a two-year college or technical school, or around two to five years of related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Some experience with 3D AutoCAD, or willingness to build on existing drafting skills.
Some experience working directly with vendors in component sizing and selection.
Ability to perform or develop calculations for stress, deflection, pipe size, pipe pressure drop, pump, and valve sizing.
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, etc.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to communicate effectively and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, etc.
Familiarity with 3D AutoCAD design software; Internet software; Excel spreadsheet software and Word, Adobe word processing software.
BS in Mechanical or Structural Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Background in a similar drafting or design role.
Exposure to specifying system components for operation and monitoring of filtration systems or similar technologies/equipment.
Some process piping design experience.
Familiarity with SolidWorks is a plus.
Exposure to inFlow Inventory software is helpful but not required.

cond_0040.intro: Work as a Mechanical Design Engineer designing process custom piping equipment. Your work stays fresh because each treatment and system design is different. This position requires someone who enjoys being challenged and can apply knowledge and resourcefulness to each design application. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of piping systems and process design.
cond_0040.responsibilities:
Develop skid-mounted capital equipment by studying customer requirements; researching and testing manufacturing and assembly methods and materials; and soliciting observations from operators.
Mechanical and methodical know-how in the design of structural frame-supported piping systems.
Selects and sizes mechanical components based on process design criteria.
Works with engineers and clients to accurately depict the desired design characteristics.
Develops manufacturing processes by designing and modifying equipment for fabricating, building, assembling, and installing components.
Produces drawings (detailed and outline designs) using standard drafting procedures.
Interfaces with outside vendors for component selection; manufacturing and assembly instructions.
Assures system and product quality by designing testing methods; testing finished product and system capabilities; and confirming fabrication, assembly, and installation processes.
Specifies system components or direct modification of products to ensure conformance with engineering design and performance specifications following testing results.
Reads and interprets blueprints, technical drawings, schematics, and computer-generated reports.
Provides engineering support by answering questions and requests from inside or outside the organization.
Seeks outside resources to assist with implementing operating procedures, resolve system malfunctions, and seek technical support/information.
cond_0040.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's degree or equivalent from a two-year college or technical school; or two to five years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with 3D AutoCAD.
Experience working directly with vendors in component sizing and selection.
Ability to perform calculations for stress, deflection, pipe size, pipe pressure drop, pump, and valve sizing.
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, etc.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, etc.
3D AutoCAD Design software; Internet software; Excel Spreadsheet software and Word, Adobe Word Processing software.
Preferred Requirements
BS in Mechanical or Structural Engineering.
Experience in a similar drafting/design role.
Experience specifying system components for operation and monitoring of filtration systems or similar technologies/equipment.
Process piping design experience.
SolidWorks experience.
InFlow Inventory software experience.
cond_0040.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0198.intro: We are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to join our team, working alongside colleagues and clients to design custom process piping equipment. Each treatment and system design is different, so the work stays varied and requires someone who can apply knowledge and resourcefulness to each application.
cond_0198.responsibilities:
Coordinate with customers, engineers, and operators to develop skid-mounted capital equipment by studying requirements, researching manufacturing and assembly methods, and gathering feedback.
Work alongside engineers and clients to accurately reflect desired design characteristics in structural frame-supported piping systems.
Select and size mechanical components based on process design criteria, in coordination with the broader project team.
Collaborate with fabrication teams to develop and refine manufacturing processes for building, assembling, and installing components.
Produce detailed and outline drawings using standard drafting procedures.
Work with outside vendors to support component selection and clarify manufacturing and assembly instructions.
Help ensure system and product quality by coordinating testing methods, evaluating finished product capabilities, and confirming fabrication, assembly, and installation processes.
Work with the team to specify system components or coordinate modifications to products so they conform with engineering design and performance specifications following testing.
Read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, schematics, and computer-generated reports.
Support engineers and other stakeholders by responding to questions and requests from inside and outside the organization.
Coordinate with outside resources to help implement operating procedures, resolve system malfunctions, and obtain technical support.
cond_0198.requirements:
Associate's degree or equivalent from a two-year college or technical school; or two to five years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with 3D AutoCAD.
Experience working directly with vendors in component sizing and selection.
Ability to perform calculations for stress, deflection, pipe size, pipe pressure drop, pump, and valve sizing.
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, etc.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, etc.
3D AutoCAD Design software; Internet software; Excel Spreadsheet software and Word, Adobe Word Processing software.
BS in Mechanical or Structural Engineering.
Experience in a similar drafting/design role.
Experience specifying system components for operation and monitoring of filtration systems or similar technologies/equipment.
Process piping design experience.
SolidWorks experience.
InFlow Inventory software experience.

Each treatment and system design is different, so the work stays varied and requires someone who can apply knowledge and resourcefulness to each application.
cond_0432.responsibilities:
Coordinate with customers, engineers, and operators to develop skid-mounted capital equipment by studying requirements, researching manufacturing and assembly methods, and gathering feedback.
Work alongside engineers and clients to accurately reflect desired design characteristics in structural frame-supported piping systems.
Select and size mechanical components based on process design criteria, in coordination with the broader project team.
Collaborate with fabrication teams to develop and refine manufacturing processes for building, assembling, and installing components.
Produce detailed and outline drawings using standard drafting procedures.
Work with outside vendors to support component selection and clarify manufacturing and assembly instructions.
Help ensure system and product quality by coordinating testing methods, evaluating finished product capabilities, and confirming fabrication, assembly, and installation processes.
Work with the team to specify system components or coordinate modifications to products so they conform with engineering design and performance specifications following testing.
Read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, schematics, and computer-generated reports.
Support engineers and other stakeholders by responding to questions and requests from inside and outside the organization.
Coordinate with outside resources to help implement operating procedures, resolve system malfunctions, and obtain technical support.
cond_0432.requirements:
Associate's degree or equivalent from a two-year college or technical school; or two to five years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with 3D AutoCAD.
Experience working directly with vendors in component sizing and selection.
Ability to perform calculations for stress, deflection, pipe size, pipe pressure drop, pump, and valve sizing.
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, etc.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, etc.
3D AutoCAD Design software; Internet software; Excel Spreadsheet software and Word, Adobe Word Processing software.
BS in Mechanical or Structural Engineering.
Experience in a similar drafting/design role.
Experience specifying system components for operation and monitoring of filtration systems or similar technologies/equipment.
Process piping design experience.
SolidWorks experience.
InFlow Inventory software experience.

cond_0452.responsibilities:
Develop skid-mounted capital equipment by studying customer requirements; researching and testing manufacturing and assembly methods and materials; and soliciting observations from operators.
Mechanical and methodical know-how in the design of structural frame-supported piping systems.
Selects and sizes mechanical components based on process design criteria.
Works with engineers and clients to accurately depict the desired design characteristics.
Develops manufacturing processes by designing and modifying equipment for fabricating, building, assembling, and installing components.
Produces drawings (detailed and outline designs) using standard drafting procedures.
Interfaces with outside vendors for component selection; manufacturing and assembly instructions.
Assures system and product quality by designing testing methods; testing finished product and system capabilities; and confirming fabrication, assembly, and installation processes.
Specifies system components or direct modification of products to ensure conformance with engineering design and performance specifications following testing results.
Reads and interprets blueprints, technical drawings, schematics, and computer-generated reports.
Provides engineering support by answering questions and requests from inside or outside the organization.
Seeks outside resources to assist with implementing operating procedures, resolve system malfunctions, and seek technical support/information.
cond_0452.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's degree or equivalent from a two-year college or technical school; or two to five years of demonstrated expertise in a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Structural Engineering required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Deep knowledge of 3D AutoCAD design software.
Proven track record working directly with vendors in component sizing and selection.
Strong command of calculations for stress, deflection, pipe size, pipe pressure drop, pump, and valve sizing.
Substantial process piping design experience.
Exceptional ability to read, analyze, and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, schematics, and computer-generated reports.
Advanced proficiency in Excel, Word, and Adobe word processing software.
Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals, and to present information effectively to groups of managers, clients, and customers.
Preferred Requirements
Demonstrated expertise in a similar drafting/design role.
Significant experience specifying system components for operation and monitoring of filtration systems or similar technologies/equipment.
Proficiency in SolidWorks.
Solid understanding of [Product name masked] inventory software.

cond_0571.intro: Work as a Mechanical Design Engineer designing process custom piping equipment. Your work stays fresh because each treatment and system design is different. This position requires someone who enjoys being challenged and can apply knowledge and resourcefulness to each design application. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of process piping and mechanical systems.
cond_0571.responsibilities:
Develop skid-mounted capital equipment by studying customer requirements; researching and testing manufacturing and assembly methods and materials; and soliciting observations from operators.
Mechanical and methodical know-how in the design of structural frame-supported piping systems.
Selects and sizes mechanical components based on process design criteria.
Works with engineers and clients to accurately depict the desired design characteristics.
Develops manufacturing processes by designing and modifying equipment for fabricating, building, assembling, and installing components.
Produces drawings (detailed and outline designs) using standard drafting procedures.
Interfaces with outside vendors for component selection; manufacturing and assembly instructions.
Assures system and product quality by designing testing methods; testing finished product and system capabilities; and confirming fabrication, assembly, and installation processes.
Specifies system components or direct modification of products to ensure conformance with engineering design and performance specifications following testing results.
Reads and interprets blueprints, technical drawings, schematics, and computer-generated reports.
Provides engineering support by answering questions and requests from inside or outside the organization.
Seeks outside resources to assist with implementing operating procedures, resolve system malfunctions, and seek technical support/information.
cond_0571.requirements:
Associate's degree or equivalent from a two-year college or technical school; or two to five years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with 3D AutoCAD.
Experience working directly with vendors in component sizing and selection.
Ability to perform calculations for stress, deflection, pipe size, pipe pressure drop, pump, and valve sizing.
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, etc.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, etc.
3D AutoCAD Design software; Internet software; Excel Spreadsheet software and Word, Adobe Word Processing software.
BS in Mechanical or Structural Engineering.
Experience in a similar drafting/design role.
Experience specifying system components for operation and monitoring of filtration systems or similar technologies/equipment.
Process piping design experience.
SolidWorks experience.
InFlow Inventory software experience.
